assertions.assertion: Explains that AddUserManagement() automatically registers IProfileService
assertions.rationale: The response has a dedicated section stating AddUserManagement() automatically registers an IProfileService so profile data flows into tokens without custom code.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that claims mapping is based on requested scopes (openid → sub, email → email)
assertions.rationale: It includes a table mapping openid → sub, profile → name/given_name, email → email/email_verified based on requested scopes.

assertions.assertion: Notes that custom user attributes can be exposed via custom identity resources
assertions.rationale: It shows defining a custom IdentityResource (company_profile) with custom user claims and allowing that scope on the client.

assertions.assertion: Sets LoginUrl and LogoutUrl in IdentityServer options to point to account pages
assertions.rationale: It sets options.UserInteraction.LoginUrl and LogoutUrl to the account pages in the IdentityServer options.
